title: Radiology Annotation – MD/DNB
description: Annotate clinical findings from radiology reports to their corresponding regions in CT, MRI, or X-ray imaging studies. Each report statement describing a specific finding must be mapped one-to-one to the corresponding visual evidence using a bounding box or supported segmentation.

title: Video Annotator – Shot Boundary Detection

The role requires strong attention to detail, familiarity with video editing techniques and annotation workflows, and the ability to maintain consistent, high-quality annotations.
